sentences.en: The new national elder-care insurance system starts next year, right?
sentences.zh: 明年将启动新的国家养老保障计划，对吧？

sentences.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
sentences.zh: 如果货物延误，我们有特别的延迟保险。

sentences.en: He claimed on the insurance after his car accident.
sentences.zh: 他车祸后向保险公司索赔了。

senses.zh: 保险，保险业,保险费,预防措施adj.体巩固球队领先局面，使对手不能因增加一分而成平局的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（使…）+sur（肯定，安全）+ance→保险
